subject.title: docs(secrets): generate secretref reference docs from target registry metadata

question: Which open SecretRef docs-generation PR should be the canonical implementation path for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/44289?
rationale: This PR and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89142 overlap, both are conflicting, and the better path depends on maintainer preference for adopting the stronger formatter/test branch or repairing this branch.

options.title: Refresh stronger sibling
options.body: Refresh https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89142 on current main, rerun proof, and use it as the canonical fix if maintainers prefer that implementation.

options.title: Repair this PR
options.body: Ask this PR to render annotations from matrix metadata, add focused tests and current-head proof, and resolve conflicts before another review.

options.title: Request one replacement
options.body: Close or pause both overlapping branches and request one narrow replacement PR if neither branch is worth adopting.

recommendation.title: Refresh stronger sibling
recommendation.body: Refresh https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89142 on current main, rerun proof, and use it as the canonical fix if maintainers prefer that implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent adjacent history on the SecretRef docs/registry surface and is the best available routing owner for choosing the implementation path.
